registry.name: Agent App Store
registry.description: A protocol-agnostic registry of agentic tools, APIs, and MCP servers that AI agents can query to discover capabilities for completing tasks.

tools.name: Perplexity Sonar API
tools.tagline: Real-time web search with citations, built for agents
tools.description: Perplexity's Sonar API provides LLM-powered web search with inline citations. Agents can query for current events, research, facts, and get grounded answers with source URLs. Supports streaming responses, search filters, and domain restrictions.

tools.name: Brave Search API
tools.description: Brave Search provides an independent search index (not proxied from Google/Bing). Agents get web results, news, images, and videos via a simple REST API. Great for agents that need unbiased, diverse search results with full snippets.

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.tagline: Full GitHub access — repos, issues, PRs, actions
tools.description: The official GitHub MCP server gives agents full access to GitHub's API through the Model Context Protocol. Create repos, manage issues, review pull requests, trigger Actions workflows, search code, and manage branches — all through structured MCP tool calls.

pricing.details: Free with GitHub account; rate limits apply

tools.name: Notion MCP Server
tools.tagline: Read and write Notion pages, databases, and blocks
tools.description: The Notion MCP server exposes optimized tools for LLMs to interact with Notion workspaces. Agents can search pages, read content, create new pages, update databases, and manage blocks. Designed specifically for agent workflows with structured tool schemas.

tools.name: Slack MCP Server
tools.tagline: Send messages, search channels, manage Slack workflows
tools.description: Agents can send messages, search conversations, list channels, manage reactions, and interact with Slack workspaces through the MCP protocol. Supports both reading and writing operations with proper scoping.

tools.name: Playwright MCP Server
tools.tagline: Browser automation — navigate, click, extract, screenshot
tools.description: The Playwright MCP server gives agents full browser automation capabilities. Navigate pages, fill forms, click elements, extract structured data, take screenshots, and handle multi-step web workflows. The most popular MCP server globally.

tools.name: Firecrawl MCP Server
tools.tagline: Turn any website into clean, LLM-ready data
tools.description: Firecrawl converts websites into clean, structured content optimized for LLMs. Strips navigation, ads, and boilerplate, returning just the content. Supports single-page extraction, full site crawling, and structured data extraction with schemas.

tools.name: Composio MCP Server
tools.tagline: One server, 250+ integrations — GitHub, Slack, Gmail, Jira, and more
tools.description: Instead of installing separate MCP servers for each service, Composio provides a single gateway to 250+ platforms. Connect GitHub, Slack, Gmail, Notion, Jira, Salesforce, HubSpot, and hundreds more through one unified MCP server. Authentication is managed centrally.

pricing.details: Free tier with limits; Pro from $29/month

tools.name: Terraform MCP Server
tools.tagline: Infrastructure as code management through MCP
tools.description: HashiCorp's official Terraform MCP server brings infrastructure-as-code management into agent workflows. Plan, apply, and manage Terraform configurations. Query state, inspect resources, and automate infrastructure changes through structured tool calls.

tools.name: Datadog MCP Server
tools.tagline: Query metrics, logs, and traces from your observability stack
tools.description: Connect agents to your Datadog observability stack. Query metrics, search logs, inspect traces, manage dashboards, and investigate incidents. Agents can proactively monitor infrastructure health and diagnose issues.

tools.name: Figma MCP Server
tools.tagline: Read Figma designs, extract tokens, generate code
tools.description: Agents can inspect Figma files, extract design tokens, read component properties, and generate code from designs. Bridge the gap between design and development by letting agents understand your design system directly.

tools.name: Google Workspace MCP Server
tools.tagline: Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Docs — all through MCP
tools.description: Access Google Workspace services through MCP. Read and send emails in Gmail, manage Google Drive files, create and query Calendar events, and interact with Google Docs and Sheets. A unified entry point for Google productivity tools.

tools.name: OpenAI API
tools.tagline: GPT, DALL-E, Whisper, and embeddings for sub-agents
tools.description: The OpenAI API gives agents access to GPT models for text generation, DALL-E for image generation, Whisper for audio transcription, and embedding models for semantic search. Agents can use these as sub-capabilities within larger workflows.

tools.name: Anthropic Claude API
tools.tagline: Claude models with tool use, vision, and extended context
tools.description: Anthropic's API provides access to Claude models with native tool use, vision capabilities, and extended context windows. Agents can delegate complex reasoning, document analysis, and multi-step tool use to Claude as a sub-agent.

tools.name: Jira MCP Server
tools.tagline: Manage issues, sprints, and projects in Jira
tools.description: The Jira MCP server lets agents create and update issues, manage sprints, query project boards, and track progress. Integrates tightly with agile workflows — agents can triage bugs, update story points, and generate sprint reports.

tools.name: Docker MCP Server
tools.tagline: Manage containers, images, volumes, and networks
tools.description: Agents can manage Docker containers, images, volumes, and networks through MCP. Start and stop containers, pull images, inspect logs, manage Docker Compose stacks, and automate deployment workflows.

tools.name: PagerDuty MCP Server
tools.description: Connect agents to PagerDuty for incident management. Trigger, acknowledge, and resolve incidents. Query on-call schedules, escalation policies, and service health. Agents can automate incident response workflows.

tools.name: Vectara MCP Server
tools.tagline: Semantic search and RAG over your data
tools.description: Vectara's MCP server enables agents to perform semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over your document collections. Upload documents, query them with natural language, and get grounded answers with reduced hallucination through Vectara's Trusted RAG platform.
